Title: Closed-Loop EEG Biofeedback for Attention Enhancement
Description: Developing an adaptive closed-loop system using active wet gel EEG electrodes to identify individual alpha peak frequencies (iAPF) and deliver real-time neurofeedback to enhance selective attention and working memory.

Title: Biosignal Markers of Cognitive Load in Virtual Reality Environments
Description: Investigating how high-frequency heart rate variability (HF-HRV) and respiration-locked arrythmias index cognitive strain and emotional regulation capacity during complex flight simulation tasks in VR.

Title: High-Resolution Pupillometry during Adaptive Interface Interaction
Description: Used a Tobii Pro Spectrum 1200Hz eye tracker to analyze pupil dilatory dynamics as a proxy for transient cognitive overload in designers performing layout optimization tasks.
